title: retro_private_audit_index/v1
description: Local-only (never public artifact/GitHub/log/fixture) sidecar manifest binding an existing public-safe agent_improvement_candidate_v1 `evidence_ref` + publication `run_identity` to private local audit evidence (Issue #2376, WS5). additionalProperties: false (top-level and every nested object) closes the key set: unknown/forbidden fields (raw transcript, prompt, tool I/O, stdout/stderr, credential, token, secret, absolute local path) fail schema validation rather than being silently accepted -- there is no free-form instruction field anywhere in this schema. `resolution_key` is a stable identity derived ONLY from `run_identity` + `evidence_ref` (Identity Separation, AC2) -- every other field here (`private_status_at_generation`/`reason_code`/`object_key`/`object_digest`/`expires_at`) is a time-varying generation-snapshot field bound instead by the separate `manifest_digest`, and access-time re-evaluation (source missing/permission changed/digest mismatch/expired) never rewrites either digest -- it only changes the transient, non-persisted `effective_status` `private_audit_resolver.resolve()` computes at read time. `object_key` is an OPAQUE path relative to a caller-configured local audit root -- never an absolute local filesystem path (AC4).

run_identity.description: The exact 3-field stable identity subset (Issue #2376 AC2) -- NOT the full publication run_identity dict, which also carries time-varying generated_at/runtime_version/source_observations that must never enter the resolution_key preimage.

evidence_ref.description: The same public-safe typed evidence_ref shape as agent_improvement_candidate_v1.schema.json's $defs.evidence_ref -- echoed here so the manifest is self-describing without needing side information, never a new/wider shape.

reason_code.description: Bounded generation-time reason (Issue #2376 AC5). Distinct from -- and never overwritten by -- the transient effective_status reason private_audit_resolver.resolve() computes at access time (source_missing/digest_mismatch/permission_denied/expired/not_registered/malformed_manifest), none of which are ever persisted back into this field.

object_key.description: Opaque path relative to the caller-configured local audit root. Never an absolute path (no leading '/', no '..' traversal segment).

expires_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp, or null meaning no resolver-owned expiry. Judged lazily at access time only by the local resolver -- never by a background daemon/cleanup service.
